findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.tweetfeed.live" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_url, get_campaigns, get_campaign_iocs, get_trends, get_feed_status, search, fetch · Private data: check_hash, search, fetch · Public sink: query_iocs, check_url, get_campaigns, get_campaign_iocs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_url, get_campaigns, get_campaign_iocs, get_trends, get_feed_status, search, fetch · Private data: check_hash, search, fetch · Public sink: query_iocs, check_url, get_campaigns, get_campaign_iocs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
